title: A back-test summary for a roof program

blocks.text: A school district (an invented one, like its data) has replaced its roof-planning model and wants a back-test: today's model was rerun on the input snapshot of each past planning cycle, and its plans must be set beside the plans those cycles approved. The district's reviewers read one summary line per cycle.

The docstring of `roof_backtest.py` gives the two inputs' shapes; a plan maps each funded roof to its start year. Write `summarize(archive, rerun)`, returning one dict per archived cycle, in archive order:

items: for a cycle with no entry in `rerun`: `{"cycle": year, "missing": True}`, since a cycle that was not rerun has no comparison to make;

otherwise `{"cycle", "missing": False, "kept", "moved", "added", "dropped", "agreement"}`, where `kept` counts approved roofs today's plan funds in the same year, `moved` those it funds in another year, `added` roofs only today's plan funds, `dropped` approved roofs it does not fund, and `agreement` is kept divided by the number of approved roofs, rounded to 3 decimals. When the cycle approved nothing, agreement is `1.0` if today's plan funds nothing too, and `0.0` if it funds anything.

blocks.text:
"""Summarize a back-test of a school district's roof-replacement model against past cycles.

archive: [{"cycle": year, "approved": {roof: start year}}, ...], the plans past cycles approved
rerun:   {year: {roof: start year}}, what today's model chose on each past cycle's snapshot
"""

from __future__ import annotations


def summarize(archive: list[dict], rerun: dict[int, dict[str, int]]) -> list[dict]:
    """One summary per archived cycle, in archive order."""
    rows = []
    for entry in archive:
        cycle, was = entry["cycle"], entry["approved"]
        if cycle not in rerun:
            rows.append({"cycle": cycle, "missing": True})
            continue
        now = rerun[cycle]
        kept = sum(1 for p in was if now.get(p) == was[p])
        moved = sum(1 for p in was if p in now and now[p] != was[p])
        if was:
            agreement = round(kept / len(was), 3)
        else:
            agreement = 1.0 if not now else 0.0
        rows.append({"cycle": cycle, "missing": False, "kept": kept, "moved": moved,
                     "added": sum(1 for p in now if p not in was),
                     "dropped": sum(1 for p in was if p not in now), "agreement": agreement})
    return rows


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(summarize([{"cycle": 2024, "approved": {"gym": 2025}}], {2024: {"gym": 2026}}))

    print(f"cycle {row['cycle']}:", row)

cases.says: each roof of a cycle is counted once as kept, added or dropped, and agreement is the share of approved roofs kept
a project both plans fund in different years is moved, not kept
a cycle today's model was not run on is marked missing, not read as a plan that dropped everything
a cycle that approved nothing agrees fully with a rerun that funds nothing

concepts: a back-test sets today's plan for each past cycle beside the plan that cycle approved
